title: Page 3
content_zh:
“你多去烧些热水送来，一会儿肯定需要。”
冯全耸肩，笑得古怪，转身出去了。
梁浩海这才拿了药瓶在童悠悠鼻下晃了晃，童悠悠慢慢醒来，抬手揉着太阳穴，待看清楚眼前情形，惊得手下一划拉，直接抓起了桌边的茶壶。
“姑娘，且慢！我们没有恶意！”梁浩海退后几步，赶紧解释道：“方才是我在敲你们家的大门，我的一个同伴因为救人中了飞刀，性命危急，城里大夫因为男女有别，不肯施救。我们没有办法，只能这么把姑娘请来救治。”
童悠悠手里的茶壶依旧没有放下，仔细打量清楚屋里，眼见床上确实躺了个浑身血迹的女子，梁浩海退得足够远，不像什么邪恶之徒，她才稍稍放了心，问道：“你们是什么人？”
梁浩海迟疑了一瞬，应道：“我们不是坏人，因为一些苦衷不能说明身分。今日只是请姑娘来救命，不会对姑娘不利。只要姑娘肯出手，过后我一定好好把姑娘送回去，不会让任何人知道，也不会坏了姑娘的名节。”
童悠悠侧头望向他，黑黝黝的大眼里满满是恼怒和怀疑，烛光照在她白皙的下颚，分外的柔美。
梁浩海心急，原本想吓唬她几句，不知道怎么就说不出口。平日查案，也不是没见过血腥、没用过手段，但任何办法，好似都不适合用在眼前的姑娘身上。
这个时候，余姑娘却突然咳嗽起来，嘴里不断涌出鲜血，很是恐怖。
不等梁浩海上前，童悠悠已经奔了过去，直接把余姑娘侧过身来，检查伤势、诊脉，一气呵成。
“她怎么伤得这么厉害，这刀子的位置，就算没有伤到心脏，也伤了肺叶。若是拔刀，活下来的机会只有一成，若是不拔刀，也挺不过两个时辰。真是太凶险了，简直是必死的伤势。”
童悠悠眉头皱得死紧，但手下可是不慢，就是鲜血染脏了她雪白的中衣，她都没有注意。
梁浩海眼里一亮，应道：“这姑娘被仇敌追杀，路上为了救一个孩童被仇敌所伤，请大夫一定要救活她，若是实在不可为，哪怕让她清醒一刻钟也好，我有重要之事问她。”
童悠悠回身瞪了他一眼，人都要死了，不但不伤心，还惦记着问话。这哪里是朋友所为，说不定他们就是追杀这姑娘的仇敌。
梁浩海被瞪得莫名其妙，还想说话，童悠悠已经发话了——
“我需要热水、干净的白色棉布条、止血药粉。”
“好，我们立刻准备。”梁浩海应得痛快。
不过片刻，药粉和布条就准备妥当，冯全也拎了两桶热水进来了。
童悠悠挽了袖子，深吸几口气给自己壮胆子。她不过是个妇科的菜鸟中医，涉及性命之事，顶多在妇产科帮忙接生过几次孩子，像这般心脏拔刀的重伤可是第一次见，但情形危急，还真不能不动手，只能靠自己的经验和所学尽力而为了。
“我只有一成把握，若是这姑娘……不好，你们不能怪我！”

“不会，姑娘尽力就好。”梁浩海郑重点头，末了扯了冯全躲去了门口。
童悠悠这才放了一半心，抬手剪开了余姑娘的衣衫，暗忖：这种时候还知道避嫌，这两人想必不会是太坏的人。
飞刀扎得实在太深了，童悠悠做足了心理准备，才猛力把飞刀拔出来，但依旧被喷了满脸的鲜血。
温热的铁锈味道，让她一瞬间恶心得几乎要吐出来，但此刻的她已顾不上，止血上药包扎，没有一道手续可以拖延半分。
“不疼，不疼啊，马上就好了，马上就好了！”童悠悠嘴里嘀咕着，不知道是在安慰伤者，还是在安慰自己。
许是疼痛太过剧烈，余姑娘居然醒了过来，入眼就看到童悠悠含着两眼的泪水，一边安慰她一边忙碌，她忍不住就笑了，慢慢从头发里摸出一根小铜管递了过去。
童悠悠看了愣住了，刚要说话，余姑娘却微微摇了头，她脑子里灵光一闪，接过铜管就塞进了自己的怀里。
余姑娘再次扯着嘴角笑了起来，眼神却慢慢没了光彩。
“不，你不能睡啊！坚持住，马上就好了！我一定能救活你！”
童悠悠惊得厉害，手下忙碌，可惜余姑娘已经没了声息。她只能扔下棉布带子，翻身而上，骑在余姑娘身上，开始按压前胸，做心脏复苏。
梁浩海和冯全听出不好，也顾不得男女有别，上前一看都是变了脸色。
余姑娘已经闭上眼睛，童悠悠每按一下，她的嘴里就涌出几滴血，太过凄惨。
“不要按了……人已经没了！”
梁浩海拦阻童悠悠，童悠悠却不肯停手，哭道：“你懂什么，这是心脏复苏，能让她的心脏再跳起来，一定能救活她！”
梁浩海没有办法，直接把她抱了下来，“人已经死了，别折腾她了。”
冯全也懊恼道：“不是说能醒来一会儿吗？还有很多话没有问她呢！”
“好了！”梁浩海开口呵斥，“死者为大！”
冯全不甘心的闭了口，他们这次南下的任务，余姑娘是个关键，如今人没了，他们的线索断了，再难寸进，说不定还要麻烦缠身。
童悠悠下意识捂住了胸口，梁浩海还以为她是吓到了，安慰道：“童姑娘，你不用害怕，我会遵守承诺，送你回去。只不过，要劳烦你替余姑娘拾掇一下妆容衣裙，才能将她安葬，我们不方便。”
“好，”童悠悠想也不想就应了下来，“最好寻一套新衣裙，时间久了，身体僵硬就不好更换了。”

冯全不知用了什么办法，出去片刻当真拿了一套绯色的新衣裙进来。
童悠悠替余姑娘擦抹干净血迹，换了新衣，甚至还把自己辫子上的珍珠发带摘了，替余姑娘重新梳理发髻。
梁浩海看在眼里，倒是对同童悠悠越发好奇。寻常人家的姑娘面对死人，别说这么帮忙，怕是立刻晕死过去。这位童姑娘却大大不同，难道真是因为身为医者，看淡生死的关系？
他哪里知道，童悠悠前世里，即便学的是中医学科，可也要对着福马林浸泡的大体，吃饭或者谈笑风生，早就习惯了。
“你们打算怎么安置这个姑娘？”
童悠悠犹豫了一下，还是问出口。虽然这姑娘不是因为她而死，但眼见一条生命就这么没了，她还是免不得伤怀。
“这姑娘命苦，家里人都没了，又不在这里，我们打算送她去义庄安置，过些日子处置完手头的事，就寻人送她的棺椁归乡埋葬。”
梁浩海想起没有完成的差事不禁皱眉。余姑娘是关键的人证，牵扯了最重要的线索，如今断了，他也头疼。
童悠悠听他这么说便放了心，以后有机会出门还能去祭拜一下。
“那你们打算杀我灭口吗？”
“哈！”不等梁浩海应声，冯全已经气得冷笑，“我们又不是强盗，怎么可能随便杀人？”
“那就好。”童悠悠也冷了脸，应道：“那就送我回去吧，不要让任何人看到。深夜出诊，已经非我所愿，若是坏了我的名声，你们就是又害了一条人命。”
“什么叫又害了一条人命？”
冯全还要争辩，梁浩海已经扯了他到一边，末了郑重地同童悠悠行礼，道歉道：“童姑娘见谅，方才实在是救人心切，我这就送你回去，一定不会被发现。”
童悠悠扫了一眼旁边那来自她床上的棉被，又道：“那就劳烦了，我祖母病了，不能费心，即便惊动外人，也不要惊动我祖母。多谢！”
content_en:
"Go and boil some more hot water and bring it over. I'll definitely need it later."
Feng Quan shrugged, smiled strangely, turned around and went out.
Liang Haohai then took the medicine bottle and shook it under Tong Youyou's nose. Tong Youyou woke up slowly and raised her hands to rub her temples. When she saw the situation clearly, she was so shocked that she pulled her hand forward and grabbed the teapot on the table.
"Girl, wait a minute! We don't mean any harm!" Liang Haohai took a few steps back and quickly explained: "I was knocking on your door just now. One of my companions was hit by a flying knife while trying to save someone, and his life is in critical condition. The doctor in the city refused to save him because of the differences between men and women. We had no choice but to invite the girl for treatment."
Tong Youyou still didn't put down the teapot in her hand. She looked around the room carefully and saw that there was indeed a woman covered in blood lying on the bed. Liang Haohai had retreated far enough and she didn't look like an evil person. She felt relieved and asked, "Who are you?"
Liang Haohai hesitated for a moment and responded: "We are not bad people, because some difficulties cannot be explained. Today I just asked the girl to save her life, and it will not be detrimental to the girl. As long as the girl is willing to take action, I will send the girl back properly in the future, and will not let anyone know, and will not damage the girl's reputation."
Tong Youyou turned her head to look at him, her big dark eyes full of anger and suspicion. The candlelight illuminated her white chin, which made her look particularly soft.
Liang Haohai was anxious. He wanted to scare her a few words, but he couldn't say it for some reason. When investigating cases on weekdays, it's not like I haven't seen bloodshed or used any methods, but any method seems unsuitable for the girl in front of me.
At this time, Miss Yu suddenly coughed, and blood kept pouring from her mouth, which was very scary.
Before Liang Haohai could step forward, Tong Youyou had already rushed over, turned Miss Yu sideways, checked her injuries and diagnosed her pulse, all in one go.
"Why was she so badly injured? The position of the knife damaged the lungs even if it didn't hurt the heart. If the knife was drawn, the chance of survival was only 10%. If the knife was not drawn, she would not have survived for two hours. It was so dangerous, it was a fatal injury."
Tong Youyou frowned tightly, but her men were not slow. She didn't even notice that the blood stained her snow-white middle coat.
Liang Haohai's eyes lit up and he responded: "This girl was chased by the enemy. She was injured by the enemy while trying to save a child on the way. Doctor, please be sure to save her. If it is really impossible, just let her wake up for a quarter of an hour. I have something important to ask her."
Tong Youyou turned around and glared at him. He was about to die. Not only was he not sad, but he still wanted to ask questions. This was not done by friends, maybe they were the enemies who were chasing this girl.
Liang Haohai was stared at in confusion and still wanted to speak, but Tong Youyou had already spoken——
"I need hot water, clean white cotton strips, and hemostatic powder."
"Okay, let's get ready immediately." Liang Haohai deserved it.
Within a moment, the medicinal powder and strips of cloth were ready, and Feng Quan also came in carrying two buckets of hot water.
Tong Youyou rolled up her sleeves and took a few deep breaths to strengthen herself. She was just a rookie Chinese medicine doctor in the gynecology department. When it came to life matters, she had helped deliver a few babies in the obstetrics and gynecology department. This was the first time she had seen a serious heart injury like this. But the situation was critical and she really had to take action. She could only rely on her own experience and knowledge to do her best.
"I'm only 10% sure. If this girl... is not good, you can't blame me!"
"No, just do your best, girl." Liang Haohai nodded solemnly, and finally pulled Feng Quan and hid at the door.
Tong Youyou was only half relieved, and raised her hand to cut off Miss Yu's clothes, thinking to herself: If they know how to avoid suspicion at this time, these two people must not be too bad people.
The flying knife pierced too deeply. Tong Youyou was mentally prepared before she pulled out the flying knife, but her face was still sprayed with blood.
The warm smell of rust made her so sick that she almost vomited.Come, but at this moment she can no longer care about stopping the bleeding and applying medicine and bandage. No procedure can delay it for even a minute.
"It doesn't hurt, it doesn't hurt, it will be fine soon, it will be fine soon!" Tong Youyou muttered, not knowing whether she was comforting the injured or comforting herself.
Perhaps the pain was too severe, and Miss Yu actually woke up. She saw Tong Youyou with tears in her eyes, comforting her and busy at the same time. She couldn't help but smile, and slowly took out a small copper tube from her hair and handed it over.
Tong Youyou was stunned. Just as she was about to speak, Miss Yu shook her head slightly. An idea flashed in her mind, and she took the copper pipe and stuffed it into her arms.
Miss Yu laughed again, but her eyes slowly lost their luster.
"No, you can't sleep! Hold on, you'll be fine soon! I can definitely save you!"
Tong Youyou was so shocked that her men were busy, but unfortunately Miss Yu had lost her voice. She could only throw down the cotton belt, turn over, sit on Miss Yu, and start to press on the chest and perform cardiopulmonary resuscitation.
Liang Haohai and Feng Quan heard something bad and didn't care about the difference between men and women. When they stepped forward, their expressions changed.
Miss Yu had closed her eyes, and every time Tong Youyou pressed her, a few drops of blood would gush out of her mouth, which was so miserable.
"Don't press it...the person is gone!"
Liang Haohai stopped Tong Youyou, but Tong Youyou refused to stop, crying: "What do you know? This is cardiac resuscitation. It can make her heart beat again, and it will definitely save her!"
Liang Haohai had no choice but to hug her down directly, "She is already dead, don't torment her."
Feng Quan also said angrily: "Didn't I say that I could wake up for a while? There are still many things I haven't asked her!"
"Okay!" Liang Haohai yelled, "The dead one is the most important!"
Feng Quan reluctantly shut up. Miss Yu was the key to their mission to the south. Now that they were gone, their clues were cut off. No matter how hard they made progress, they might be in trouble.
Tong Youyou subconsciously covered her chest. Liang Haohai thought she was frightened and comforted her: "Miss Tong, you don't have to be afraid. I will keep my promise and send you back. However, we have to trouble you to tidy up Miss Yu's makeup and clothes before she can be buried. It's inconvenient for us."
"Okay," Tong Youyou agreed without thinking, "It's best to find a new set of clothes. After a long time, your body will become stiff and it will be difficult to change."
Feng Quan didn't know what method he used. He went out for a while and actually brought in a new set of crimson clothes.
Tong Youyou wiped off the blood for Miss Yu, changed into new clothes, and even took off the pearl hairband from her own braid, and rearranged Miss Yu's bun.
Liang Haohai saw this and became more and more curious about his fellow student Youyou. An ordinary girl would faint immediately when facing a dead person, let alone helping him like this. This little girl is very different. Is it really because as a doctor, she looks down on the relationship between life and death?
Little did he know that in Tong Youyou's previous life, even if she studied traditional Chinese medicine, she was already used to having to eat or talk and laugh in front of formalin-soaked bodies.
"How do you plan to settle this girl?"
Tong Youyou hesitated for a moment before asking. Although this girl did not die because of her, she still couldn't help but feel sad when she saw a life lost like this.
"This girl's life is miserable. Her family is gone and she is not here. We plan to send her to a charity village for resettlement. After a few days, after we have taken care of the things at hand, we will find someone to take her coffin back home for burial."
Liang Haohai couldn't help but frown when he thought of the unfinished errands. Miss Yu is a key witness, and it involves the most important clue. Now that it is broken, he also has a headache.
Tong Youyou felt relieved when he heard what he said, and she could go to worship when she had the chance to go out in the future.
"Then do you plan to kill me to silence me?"
"Ha!" Before Liang Haohai could respond, Feng Quan sneered angrily, "We are not robbers, how can we kill people casually?"
"ThenJust fine. "Tong Youyou also had a cold face and responded: "Then send me back, don't let anyone see it. Visiting doctors late at night is no longer what I want. If you ruin my reputation, you will kill another life. "
"What do you mean, another life was taken? "
Feng Quan was still going to argue, but Liang Haohai had already pulled him aside. Finally, he solemnly saluted Tong Youyou and apologized: "Miss Tong, please forgive me. I was really eager to save people just now. I will send you back right away. You will not be discovered." "
Tong Youyou glanced at the quilt from her bed next to her, and said: "That's troublesome, my grandmother is sick, so I can't bother. Even if I alert outsiders, don't alert my grandmother. Thank you! "
